plan.title: AD lesional vs control: DE genes + hallmark pathways
plan.analytical_narrative: Data are raw gene-level counts (salmon-derived, tximport not required since counts.csv is already gene-level) for 6 AD-lesional vs 6 control skin samples, single batch, unpaired. One sample (sample_01) has library size ~4x below median — per the design-knowledge rule (R-0008/R-0030) this is inspected and reported, never silently dropped, since DESeq2's size-factor normalization accounts for depth. Track 1 runs QC (library sizes, blind-VST PCA, sample-distance heatmap with sample_01 flagged), then the DESeq2 pre-filter -> median-of-ratios normalization -> Wald test -> apeglm LFC shrinkage -> BH-adjusted results, with a documented decision on whether sample_01 is kept or excluded based on the QC evidence. A parallel edgeR quasi-likelihood F-test on the same design gives a second differential-expression method; the report treats the DESeq2/edgeR intersection as the high-confidence gene set (R-0001, R-0042). Track 2 takes the DESeq2 Wald statistic as the preranked metric for fgsea against MSigDB Hallmark (2026.1, 50 human gene sets) with a Reactome follow-up pass, both against the universe of tested genes with a 15-500 gene size window and BH correction. The final report step integrates both tracks: DE gene table (shrunken + unshrunken LFC), fit diagnostics (MA plot, dispersion plot), enrichment tables with leading-edge genes, and full reproducibility record (session info, package versions, gene set collection versions, seeds).
